name: Chef's Selection – Seasonal Small Bites Platter
description: A tasting plate of small dishes, handpicked by our staff. Each set is different—what you get is a surprise! A perfect way to sample a variety of flavors.

name: Creamy Egg Potato Salad with Miso Mayo
description: Homestyle potato salad with soft-boiled eggs and special miso mayo sauce.

name: Shin Fermented Fried Chicken
description: Minimalist, umami-rich fried chicken marinated with onion koji and garlic, then fermented and fried.

name: Carpaccio
description: Delicate carpaccio-style slices served with a house dressing. Ask our staff for today's preparation.

name: Seasonal Vegetable Platter
description: Seasonal vegetables, artfully presented, coated with Kāchan miso and torched cheese. Rustic and elegant.

name: Fermented Potato Fries
description: Fries made from Japanese potatoes, salt-water fermented before frying. Unique tangy umami flavor.

name: Wagyu Beef Tendon Stew
description: Slow-braised Japanese wagyu beef tendon, simmered until meltingly tender. Deeply savory and rich with collagen, this hearty dish pairs beautifully with sake or a cold beer.

name: Pickled Local Vegetables with Homemade Koji
description: A colorful assortment of locally grown vegetables, pickled with a variety of our house-made koji. Crisp, refreshing, and rich in natural umami.

name: Pâté du Jour
description: A rustic, handcrafted pâté made from seasonal ingredients. Rich, deeply flavored, and perfect with a glass of wine or sake. Ask our staff for today's creation.

name: Oden
description: Slow-simmered in a light, flavorful dashi broth, our Oden features a variety of seasonal ingredients, gently cooked to soak up umami.

name: Choi-Nomi / Yoidore Set
description: "Choi-Nomi" is a light drinking set — one staff-selected appetizer paired with your choice of premium drink (beer, sake, highball, or wine). "Yoidore" is the full experience: a curated spread of five dishes with a drink. Perfect for a casual evening or a celebratory toast.

name: Afternoon Sipping Set
description: A midday drinking set—a relaxed pairing of a house-selected appetizer with your choice of beer, sake, or wine. Perfect for a leisurely afternoon at Mitsukabōzu.

name: Seasonal Small Plates
description: A rotating selection of seasonal small plates, handcrafted with fermented seasonings and local ingredients. Ask our staff for today's selection.

name: Numbing Spicy Pork Rice Bowl
description: A lunchtime rice bowl topped with tender ground pork in a lip-tingling Sichuan-style numbing spice sauce. The interplay of heat and fragrant sansho pepper makes it an addictive midday treat.

name: Meat Miso Rice
description: Steamed Japanese rice topped with our house-made meat miso—savory minced pork simmered with fermented miso and aromatics. A satisfying side that pairs perfectly with any ramen or as a light meal on its own.

name: Steamed White Rice
description: Freshly cooked Japanese short-grain rice. Simple, comforting, and the perfect accompaniment to any dish.
